# BREAKING: Hawaza Prime Minister WintrLine Resigns

WintrLine has resigned as Prime Minister of Hawaza.

In an announcement to Hawaza members, WintrLine said his decision was not out of fear or weakness, but so he could focus on rules and on members who break them. He will remain a member of Hawaza.

WintrLine signed Hawaza's war declarations against RUOT and the UDC, as well as Operation Sword of the Levant. It is not yet clear who will replace him.

More information will follow.

**Journalists:** @revnova.

# Black Cats Central Declares War on Phoenician Empire and Army of Christ Our Lord

Black Cats Central (BCC) has declared war on the Phoenician Empire and the Army of Christ Our Lord.

According to a BCC representative, the declaration comes in response to both factions attacking BCC.

Neither the Phoenician Empire nor the Army of Christ Our Lord has publicly responded at the time of writing. BCBN hasn't independently verified the attacks.

We'll update this story as it develops.

# BREAKING: URFR Declares War on Hawaza

The Union of Robloxian Federal Republics (URFR) has declared war on Hawaza, according to a declaration signed by URFR Secretary-General dinoking1234gta and the URFR's cabinet.

In the declaration, the URFR accused Hawaza of attacking neutral factions and peaceful players, placing bounties on people, and attacking the URFR's allies. The URFR said it decided to stand with its allies after a meeting of its cabinet and advisors.

The URFR had previously sanctioned Hawaza and pledged to assist its allies in the UDC.

The declaration comes shortly after Hawaza Prime Minister WintrLine resigned. Hawaza is now at war with the UDC, the GIE and the URFR.

More information will follow.

**Journalists:** @revnova.
